hooks.command: count=$(git -C /home/user/Eskolia diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep '\.dart$' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$count" -le 3 ]; then label='leger'; suggestion='rien'; elif [ "$count" -le 6 ]; then label='moyen'; suggestion='/compact recommande'; else label='CHARGE'; suggestion='/compact maintenant'; fi; echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Contexte : $label ($count fichiers Dart touches) — $suggestion\"}"
